verdict.rationale: Chroma is a vector/search database rather than an agent or tool-using application, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers (the MCP-client role) does not fit this kind of product. The evidence only documents Chroma's own MCP server, which lets Claude call Chroma; that is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
